description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the LiveSignalEnforcement class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. It uses JUnit and Akka TestKit to verify enforcement of policies and ACLs on live signals such as commands, events, and messages within the system.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcementTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing enforcement of live signal handling (commands, messages, events) based on ACLs and policies within the system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and initializes mock entities actor before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: rejectLiveThingCommandByAcl
methods.description: Tests that a live command on a thing with empty ACLs is rejected due to access control.

methods.name: rejectLiveThingCommandByPolicy
methods.description: Tests that a live command on a thing with a policy that denies access is rejected.

methods.name: acceptLiveThingCommandByAcl
methods.description: Tests that a live command on a thing with proper ACL permissions is accepted.

methods.name: acceptLiveThingCommandByPolicy
methods.description: Tests that a live command on a thing with a proper policy is accepted.

methods.name: rejectMessageCommandByAcl
methods.description: Tests rejection of a message command when ACLs deny access.

methods.name: rejectMessageCommandByPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection of a message command when policies deny access.

methods.name: acceptMessageCommandByAcl
methods.description: Tests acceptance of a message command with proper ACL permissions.

methods.name: acceptMessageCommandByPolicy
methods.description: Tests acceptance of a message command with proper policies.

methods.name: acceptFeatureMessageCommandByPolicy
methods.description: Tests acceptance of a feature message command based on policy permissions.

methods.name: rejectLiveEventByAcl
methods.description: Tests rejection of live events when ACLs deny access.

methods.name: rejectLiveEventByPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection of live events based on policy restrictions.

methods.name: acceptLiveEventByAcl
methods.description: Tests acceptance of live events when ACLs permit.

methods.name: acceptLiveEventByPolicy
methods.description: Tests acceptance of live events based on policy permissions.

methods.name: newEnforcerActor
methods.description: Creates a new enforcer actor for testing, connecting the test actorRef with the system and mocked entities actor.

methods.name: newThingWithPolicyId
methods.description: Utility to create a JSON representation of a thing with a specific policy ID.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Creates default DittoHeaders with authorization and schema version info.

methods.name: newThing
methods.description: Builds a new ThingBuilder instance with preset ID and revision.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveThing command for testing.

methods.name: writeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyFeature command for testing.

methods.name: thingMessageCommand
methods.description: Constructs a SendThingMessage command with a sample message.

methods.name: thingMessageCommandResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for a given message command.

methods.name: featureMessageCommand

methods.name: liveEvent
